description: Scrubbed pbbp2 frame shapes for the Lark frame codec tests. Field numbers: SeqID=1, LogID=2 (uint64); service=3, method=4 (int32, 0=control, 1=data); headers=5 (repeated {key=1, value=2}); payloadEncoding=6, payloadType=7 (optional string); payload=8 (optional bytes); LogIDNew=9 (optional string). The reference encoder is proto2-style: fields 1-4 are written unconditionally, even when zero.

ping_frame.comment: control liveness frame sent by the client every PingInterval; SeqID/LogID are 0

single_fragment_event_frame.comment: data frame whose sum header is 1 (or absent) passes through the reassembler directly; payload is UTF-8 JSON

multi_fragment_event_frame.comment: data frame of a fragmented message: fragments share message_id, sum is the total count, seq is the zero-based index; reassembled payload is UTF-8 JSON

receipt_frame.comment: data frame sent back after the handler completes: the inbound frame's headers plus biz_rt (handler wall time in ms); payload is JSON {code:200,data?} or {code:500}; data is base64(JSON of the handler return value)
